'''Vengeful Cry''' is a [[Warcry]]/[[Retaliation]] [[active skill gem|skill]] that [[taunt]]s nearby enemies and grants a buff to the user and nearby allies that grants [[Rage]] over time, increased maximum Rage, and prevents Rage from decaying. This skill becomes usable after taking a [[Savage Hit]]. ==Skill functions and interactions== * '''Power''': {{c|help|Normal Monsters have 1 Power, Magic Monsters 2, Rare Monsters 10, Unique Monsters 20, and Players 5}} * {{c|mod|Buff prevents inherent loss of Rage}}: This stat only prevents the natural decay of Rage; this does not prevent the consumption of Rage as a cost, losing Rage through other effects, or accelerated loss through {{il|Berserk}}. * Vengeful Cry cannot be supported by {{il|Autoexertion}}. It is possible to trigger it via {{il|The Eternal Apple}}, however. ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression |c1_abbr = Warcry
Speed |c1_header = x% increased Warcry Speed |c1_pattern_extract = (%d+)%% increased Warcry Speed |c1_pattern_value = %d%% }} {{Item acquisition}} {{Skill threshold jewel list|where=item_stats.id LIKE "%jewel_warcry%"}} {{Alternate skill effect list|query= items.class_id="Microtransaction" AND cosmetic_items.cosmetic_type LIKE "Skill Gem Effect" AND ( items.name LIKE "%warcry%" OR items.description LIKE "%warcry%" ) }} ==Version history== {{Version history table header}} {{Version history table row|3.25.0| * Added a new Strength Skill Gem, Vengeful Cry: Retaliate against a savage hit with a warcry, taunting all nearby enemies to attack the user. The user and nearby allies gain a buff which grants rage and prevents rage from being lost. * Vengeful Cry is now offered to the Marauder for completing Lost in Love, and can be purchased from Clarissa by the Duelist and Scion. }} {{Version history table end}} {{Navbox Skills}}
